data_type: Vector occurrence records (ticks, mosquitoes, biting midges, sandflies)
access_method: GBIF-hosted occurrence search, shapefile download, web viewer
update_freq_desc: Periodic upload to GBIF (interval not published)
temporal_cov_desc: Continuous since 2014; VectorNet in its third phase (2024-2028)
license_type: Not explicitly published on portal (GBIF-hosted; typically CC0/CC-BY)
governance_body: ECDC and EFSA jointly via the One-Health VectorNet Entomological Network (OHVEN)
notes: Joint ECDC/EFSA project since May 2014, now in third iteration (2024-2028). Validated by a network of medical/veterinary entomologists across EU member states and neighbouring countries.

data_type: Species distribution maps (presence/introduced/absent/unknown) for 7 tick species
access_method: Static map files published on ECDC website; historical versions searchable
update_freq_desc: Irregular (evidence shows updates roughly every 1-3 years; latest observed June 2026 vs prior October 2023)
license_type: ECDC copyright/IP notice applies; not an open data license
standards_used: VectorNet network validation; NUTS administrative geography
notes: Covers Dermacentor reticulatus, Hyalomma lusitanicum, H. marginatum, Ixodes persulcatus, I. ricinus, Ornithodoros erraticus, Rhipicephalus sanguineus. Maps state they 'do not represent the official view or position of the countries.' Built on VectorNet (SYS01) validated records.

data_type: Research coordination network output (no centralised occurrence dataset)
access_method: Publications, training schools, short-term scientific missions; no shared database
update_freq_desc: Action runs 2022-2026; no data update cycle (coordination network, not a data system)
license_type: Publications generally open access per COST norms; no dataset license (no shared dataset)
notes: A COST Action, not a data portal: coordinates European partner countries applying the DAMA protocol to anticipate tick-borne disease risk. Included here because it is frequently cited alongside data systems in the interoperability literature, but it produces no queryable dataset of its own.

operator_org: RIVM (Netherlands Centre of Expertise on Lyme disease / NLe partners)
data_type: Tick bite + symptom + longitudinal health-outcome reports
update_freq_desc: Weekly participant prompts; continuous data collection
temporal_cov_desc: Multi-year running programme, longitudinal 1-year follow-up per participant
license_type: Not published (no explicit open-data license found)
governance_body: RIVM (Dutch national institute for public health and environment)
notes: Part of the Netherlands Centre of Expertise on Lyme disease. In 2025 recorded the most tick bite reports in five years (6,035 in 2024). Includes longitudinal follow-up for erythema migrans and long-term Lyme outcomes.

operator_org: University of Turku (Tick Project) with Pfizer Oy Finland
data_type: Citizen tick observations via live map
update_freq_desc: Updated daily according to submitted observations
temporal_cov_desc: Continuous since April 2021; >220,000 observations to date
license_type: Pfizer Oy copyright notice; no open license published
governance_body: University of Turku (research) / Pfizer Oy Finland (site maintenance/funding)
notes: Tracks Ixodes ricinus and I. persulcatus per the associated Sormunen et al. research, though the public site itself only says 'ticks'. Commercially co-funded by Pfizer, which is disclosed but not governed by an independent public body. Support inbox states emails 'will not be answered.'
